item.title: Baby goat falls after suddenly freezing mid-jump; an inherited muscle condition explains why
item.description: Fainting goats do not actually faint. Also known as myotonic goats, they have a rare inherited muscle condition called myotonia congenita that causes their muscles to become temporarily stiff when they are startled. The breed is valued for its heavy muscling, meat production, strong maternal instincts and ability to thrive on forage-based farming, making it much more than its unusual behaviour.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: A church, a Jesus statue and a border wall: Inside Trump's latest land acquisition battle
item.description: The US government seeks land for a border wall near Mount Cristo Rey. This sacred site is a pilgrimage destination for thousands of faithful people. The Roman Catholic Diocese of Las Cruces opposes the land acquisition and wall construction. Church officials argue the wall infringes upon religious freedom and desecrates the holy place. A legal battle is underway as the government pursues eminent domain for the project.

item.description: Dave Bautista highlights his humble beginnings and the hard work behind his success. He stresses that personal circumstances do not dictate future achievements. Bautista faced significant rejection before finding acting roles in Hollywood. His career shift from wrestling to acting took considerable time and effort. The actor encourages pursuing dreams despite obstacles and doubts.

item.title: TikToker Sara Gilson's final TikTok takes heartbreaking meaning after alleged murder-suicide by estranged husband
item.description: Famous TikToker Sara Gilson died after her estranged husband allegedly killed her. Police believe Jeremiah Duffey shot Sara before taking his own life. Court records show Sara had filed for divorce and received a protective order. Her final TikTok video now carries a heartbreaking and tragic meaning. A GoFundMe page was created to support her two children.

item.title: Kai Cenat announces first livestream with Tyla since she friend-zoned him on stream
item.description: Popular streamer Kai Cenat will livestream with South African singer Tyla again soon. This marks their first stream together since a viral 2024 moment. Tyla politely declined Kai's date request, becoming a popular internet meme. Fans anticipate their reunion, wondering if they will reference the past event. Both artists have achieved significant success in their respective careers.

item.title: Quote of the day by Queen Elizabeth: "When life seems hard, the courageous do not lie down and accept defeat; instead, they…" - a timeless lesson on courage, perseverance and hope in difficult times
item.description: Queen Elizabeth II's 2008 Christmas broadcast offered wisdom on facing life's difficulties. She stated that courageous individuals struggle for a better future instead of accepting defeat. This perspective highlights that courage involves refusing to let fear or pain dictate actions. Staying determined after setbacks keeps future possibilities open, which is more important than immediate wins. Hope is an active pursuit, requiring effort to achieve improvements rather than passive wishing.

item.title: Unesco adds Mount Olympus, France's D-Day landing beaches to World Heritage List
'Crimes against humanity' complaints filed against Bangladesh ex-president
item.description: Complaints were filed against former Bangladesh President Mohammed Shahabuddin on Sunday. These allegations concern crimes against humanity during the 2024 uprising against the government. Shahabuddin resigned from his presidential post on Friday citing health complications. The home minister stated the allegations do not warrant consideration by the tribunal. However, the law minister confirmed Shahabuddin will face a corruption probe.
item.dc:creator: Ahsan Tasnim

item.title: Quote of the day by Slavoj Žižek: 'The problem for us is not are our desires satisfied or not...'
item.description: Navigating modern life leaves many of us unclear about our true aspirations. The myriad choices presented by society can cloud our vision, making it hard to identify what we genuinely seek. Often, external factors influence our perceived goals, leading us to chase after things that don’t resonate with us. To find real fulfillment, we must delve into the origins of our desires and distinguish them from borrowed ambitions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Quote of the day by Thucydides: 'Self-control is the chief element in self-respect, and...'
item.description: Self-control is the foundation of self-respect, which ultimately nurtures genuine courage. Archidamus II of Sparta championed patience as a virtue over the urge for instant conflict. In Ancient Greece, ideas like sophrosyne highlighted the importance of achieving balance through self-mastery. In our fast-paced modern world, we often feel pressured to act impulsively. Cultivating self-discipline can enhance our decision-making capabilities across various situations.

item.title: China’s new hybrid rice can preserve its high-yield traits across generations, allowing farmers to...
item.description: Innovative Chinese scientists introduced a self-cloning hybrid rice system that ensures impressive yields while allowing farmers to reuse seeds. This groundbreaking method cuts down on the need for yearly seed purchases, significantly lowering production costs for agricultural operations worldwide. Consequently, this advancement plays a crucial role in enhancing food security on both national and global scales, promising to bolster China's agricultural strength.

item.title: A stormwater pond in Calgary appears filled with Prussian carp; the invasive fish can produce...
item.description: In Calgary, invasive Prussian carp are infiltrating the stormwater system, creating a serious threat to local ecology. These fish breed swiftly, endangering aquatic life and city infrastructure. Simultaneously, encounters with elk in Canadian parks are becoming more perilous than those with bears due to their massive size and unpredictable behavior, prompting authorities to implement management strategies to confront both wildlife conflicts and invasive species.

item.description: A young Canadian entrepreneur, just eleven years old, started a trash-bin cleaning service to earn some pocket money. His venture quickly attracted a large social media following and a multitude of clients, particularly during a tough summer job market for teens. With plans to keep the business growing into the colder months, he stands as an inspiring example for children worldwide to initiate their own entrepreneurial journeys.
